description: PVDeg is the National Laboratory of the Rockies package for modelling degradation in photovoltaic modules. It contains moisture, ultraviolet, thermal and light-induced degradation calculations, material parameters, scenario workflows and Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation. Inputs combine module properties with weather from sources such as NSRDB or PVGIS; outputs estimate degradation responses and associated reliability or lifetime indicators. Coverage follows the selected sites or geospatial weather grid, with time resolution determined by the forcing and mechanism. Python source is free under BSD-3-Clause. A limitation is that material parameters and represented degradation mechanisms bound the predictions; uncertainty sampling does not establish field validity. The tools can inform replacement and yield scenarios for electricity infrastructure. BatteryLife (platform-batterylife) offers a related component-life modelling resource. Python 3.10 or later is documented, and optional PySAM support has separate dependencies.
